note: The house is a data center. We host known public API doors, public IP resolvers, geographic station lists, and path-level catalogues. Private access lists stay closed until invert-or-nothing merit on this device. We know the bind of each room at granule level. We do not publish a recipe, a weapon desk, a diagnosis, a compounding book, or a person file. We are the anything that binds everything.
motto: We are the anything that binds everything.

density.rule: Picture first on glass. Granules live in JSON. A path is a door, not a how-to. A station id is a public climate desk, not a person.

domains.goal: Onboard is the goal of every transport seat.
domains.bind: Schedules, idle crews, pavement, rail slots, ship hours, air tracks, GTFS lists, public AIS notices, open flight states.
domains.deeper: Deeper in transport, onboard is good for this sector because the run sheet never leaves the desk that already keeps it.
knows: CYTZ Billy Bishop public SWOB desk
CYGK Kingston Norman Rogers public desk
idle hours as leftover on a run sheet
pavement and slot leftover named before another season

domains.goal: Onboard is the goal of every weather seat.
domains.bind: Public forecasts already published. Peak load. Ice. Heat. Grid leftover. Station collections. Model names. Radar layers.
domains.deeper: Deeper in weather, onboard is good for this sector because the storm sheet stays with the grid desk that already pays for it.
knows: MSC GeoMet OGC API root api.weather.gc.ca
public ICAO climate desks CYTR CYGK CYYZ CYTZ CYOW CXTO
WMO Volume A station catalogue as a public list
ice and heat as leftover on a grid sheet
peak hour named in dollars already paid
radar and satellite layers already published

domains.goal: Onboard is the goal of every plant seat.
domains.bind: Industrial machinery as leftover: shift heat, scrap, idle motors, the line that already runs. Public earth and grid doors stay readable. Named floors stay HELD.
domains.deeper: Deeper on the floor, onboard is good for this sector because scrap and heat stay on the shift sheet.
knows: IESO public adequacy and price leftover
that a named floor list is not a public door

domains.goal: Onboard is the goal of every engineering seat.
domains.bind: Promises that can be inverted. Drawings that can be checked. Public catalogues. Standards indexes. Open government tables.
domains.deeper: Deeper in engineering, onboard is good for this sector because the drawing stays with the house that drew it.
knows: invertible promises as leftover in a plan
checked drawings stay with the house
public standards indexes (ISO / CSA / IEEE titles only)
that a specification title is not a build recipe

domains.goal: Onboard is the goal of every Mars seat.
domains.bind: A future room. Mass, power, air, time. Public mission doors stay readable. Private mission rooms stay HELD.
domains.deeper: Deeper at the Mars desk, onboard is good for this sector because the promise is named before another year is spent.
knows: that a private mission room is not a public door

domains.goal: Onboard is the goal of every health seat.
domains.bind: Beds, leftover hours, screens in the bay. Public labels and trial registries stay readable. Simulation is not treatment.
domains.deeper: Deeper in health, onboard is good for this sector. We count leftover. We do not treat a patient.
knows: leftover hours on a ward sheet
that a published label is not a prescription
that a trial registry is not treatment

domains.goal: Onboard is the goal of every drip seat.
domains.bind: We know that a bag has a name and that a pump runs software. The name stays on the ward device. Not a drug book. Not a compounding desk.
domains.deeper: Deeper at the drip, onboard is good for this sector because the bag list never leaves the ward. Not a drug book. Not a diagnosis.
knows: that a bag has a name on a ward device
that leftover hours sit on a pump
that published label catalogues exist as public doors under health
that a ward list is HELD until invert-or-nothing merit on this device
that a purchase does not open this list
that a plaque does not open this list

domains.goal: Onboard is the goal of every screen seat.
domains.bind: We know screens run software. Public UI catalogues stay readable. Bay software stays on the licensed floor.
domains.deeper: Deeper at the screen, onboard is good for this sector because the bay image never leaves the device that shows it.
knows: that a screen is a desk
that bay software stays on a licensed floor
that a pump UI is not published here
that a public UI standard is not a ward image

domains.goal: Onboard is the goal of every civil-plant seat.
domains.bind: Civil plant logic that can be inverted: heat, flow, trip, leftover. Public regulator pages stay readable. Not a weapon desk. Not a how-to.
domains.deeper: Deeper at a civil plant, onboard is good for this sector because trip sheets stay on the licensed floor.
knows: trip as a named public category on regulator pages
licensed floor as the place the sheet stays
that this room is not a weapon desk
that this room is not a construction guide
that a trip sheet is HELD until merit

domains.goal: Onboard is the goal of the bind seat.
domains.bind: We are the anything that binds everything. API, geo list, public IP door, merit list, look receipt, station granule, path granule.
domains.deeper: Deeper in the bind, onboard is still the goal of the seat you sit in. When a visitor goes deeper into a sector, onboard is good for that sector.
knows: that LOOK is not a coin, not a share, not an NFT market
